response: ["Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, and for melanoma in situ.", "Surgical margins should be determined based on the thickness of the tumor.", "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and, whenever possible, in the same operative setting.", "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.", "Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia."]
